scope: Word merged cells (w:gridSpan / w:vMerge): read, draw and edit them the way Office 365 Word does

reference.word: Office 365 Word table Layout tab: Merge group (Merge Cells, Split Cells), cell runs selected by dragging or Shift+click
reference.gapBefore: The parser treated every w:tc as its own cell, so a w:gridSpan cell drew as several cells and a w:vMerge restart/continue pair drew as a stacked cell plus an empty one. The Table tab had no Merge/Split commands.
reference.sample: plugins/office-webapp/web/samples/sample-merged-cells.docx (3x3 table, one w:vMerge pair) + sample-real-proposal.docx (546 pages, 1 w:gridSpan cell and 2 w:vMerge pairs in its 839-row table)

changes.model: types.ts: WordCellSpan { colSpan?, vMerge? } and WordBlock.cellSpans / WordNestedTable.cellSpans
changes.parse: docx.ts + word-tables.ts readTableSpans: every w:tcPr w:gridSpan (>=2) and w:vMerge (val=restart or bare = continue)
changes.render: office-webapp.component.html: <td colspan/rowspan> from tableCellLayout; continue cells of a vertical merge are not drawn; a page fragment that starts inside a merge draws the continue cell as a normal cell so no content is lost
changes.commands: word-tables.ts: mergeTableCells (rectangular run -> one cell, w:gridSpan + w:vMerge restart/continue, text joined in the first cell), splitTableCells (rows x columns, default 1x1 = unmerge), grid-aware insertTableColumn/deleteTableColumn (a merged cell is one column boundary, w:tcW follows gridSpan)
changes.ui: word-ribbon.ts: new Merge group with tableMergeCells / tableSplitCells and two Fluent icons; component: wordCellSelection signal, drag (mousedown/mousemove) and Shift+click selection, .op-word-cell-selected highlight, Split Cells panel with rows/columns inputs
changes.measurement: office-webapp.component.ts: the per-cell line measurement keys cells by td data-cell instead of DOM order, because hiding the continue cells shifted every cell of that row
changes.i18n: office.rb.group.tableMerge, office.word.table.mergeCells, office.word.table.splitCells, office.word.table.splitCellsHint, office.word.table.split in all 13 web locales and the plugin bundle
changes.sample: web/scripts/make-merged-cells-sample.mts writes samples/sample-merged-cells.docx for the QA probe

probes.parseAndDraw: sample-merged-cells.docx: row 2 cell 'Tall' renders rowspan=2; the two rows below it show only their own cells (Three, Four) - text is not shifted
probes.selection: mouse drag from row 0 cell 0 to row 0 cell 1: 2 td carry .op-word-cell-selected
probes.merge: click Gộp ô in the Table tab: row 0 becomes 2 td, first with colspan=2 and text 'Alpha Beta'
probes.split: click Tách ô: the Split Cells panel opens with the 1x1 default; applying it turns the merged cell back into a normal cell (no colspan)
probes.realDoc: sample-real-proposal.docx: 546 pages, 4 td[rowspan=2] (2 merges seen in the page fragments) and 2 td[colspan=6], 0 console errors
probes.measurementFix: before the data-cell fix the same probe read row 2 as 'Thre' / '' because the measurement indexed cells by DOM order

verification.uiBuild: npm run office:ui:build - main.js 994.88 kB, styles.css 146.45 kB
verification.i18n: web 3285 keys, all 13 locales 100% strict parity; mobile 100%
verification.screenshot: docs/sprints/sprint_12_office_webapp/08_testing/evidence/word-merged-cells.png (merged 'Tall' cell, Table tab with the Merge group)
verification.console: 0 exceptions, 0 console errors during load, selection, merge and split
